content.value: An SCR half-wave rectifier circuit is adjusted to have a gate current of 1mA. The (12) [CO1] forward breakdown voltage of SCR is 150V for $I _ { G } = 1 m A$ . If a sinusoidal voltage of 400V peak is applied, find: (i) firing angle, (ii) conduction angle, (iii) average output voltage, (iv) average output current for a load resistance of 200Ω, (v) power output, (vi) comment on the changes in average output current if firing angle is made larger.
